name: MonarchReadReceipt
title: ReadReceipt
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row with androidx.compose.foundation.clickable, MonarchAvatarGroup and MonarchAvatar
summary: "Seen", "Seen by 3" or the readers' avatars under the newest message the other people have read, with the full list of names for TalkBack.
whenToUse: Under the newest message of a conversation that the other people have read, fed by the app with who has read it.
whenNotToUse: Not for the sending or delivery state of a message; show that in the message itself. Not for who is in a document now; use MonarchPresenceAvatars.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchReadReceipt(readers: List<MonarchReadReceiptReader>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, display: MonarchReadReceiptDisplay = MonarchReadReceiptDisplay.Text, maxAvatars: Int = 3, onShowReaders: (() -> Unit)? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchReadReceiptLabels = MonarchReadReceiptLabels(), interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)
public class MonarchReadReceiptReader(name: String, id: String? = null, image: Painter? = null)
public enum class MonarchReadReceiptDisplay { Text, Count, Avatars }
public class MonarchReadReceiptLabels(seen: String? = null, seenByCount: ((Int) -> String)? = null, seenBy: ((String) -> String)? = null, list: ((List<String>) -> String)? = null)

options.name: readers
options.description: Who has read the message, in order. Leave the sender out. Nothing is drawn while it is empty.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the receipt. The conversation's own layout aligns it under the message.

options.name: display
options.description: Text shows "Seen", Count shows "Seen by 3", Avatars shows the readers' faces and "Seen".

options.name: maxAvatars
options.description: With the avatars display, at most this many faces, then a "+N" tile. At least one face is shown.

options.name: onShowReaders
options.description: Makes the receipt a button, for example to open the list of readers with times.

options.name: icon
options.description: A decorative mark before the text of the text and count displays, such as a double check. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings: seen, seenByCount, seenBy and list.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The interaction source of the button, when onShowReaders is given.

states.name: empty
states.description: Nothing is drawn and nothing is read.

states.name: avatars
states.description: Overlapping 24dp avatars of the readers, a "+N" tile for the rest, and "Seen".

states.name: button
states.description: With onShowReaders the receipt is a button with a 48dp touch target and a ripple.

appearance: Caption text and the mark in the muted text color; avatars with their fallback colors and a ring in the surface color; the "+N" tile on the muted background. The same roles in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Same displays, wording and +N rule as the web and iOS. The web's align property is not offered: the conversation's layout aligns the receipt with the modifier. Avatars are 24dp, the smallest MonarchAvatar size, where the web uses 16 pixels. The web draws a double check glyph; Monarch bundles no icons, so the mark is the optional icon slot and the text carries the meaning. Names are joined with built-in strings ("Ana, Ben and Chloé") because android.icu.text.ListFormatter needs API 26 and minSdk is 24; replace the join with labels.list. The web shows the full sentence as a hover title; Android has no hover on touch screens, so it is only read by TalkBack.
accessibility: The receipt is one TalkBack element whose name is the full sentence, "Seen by Ana, Ben and Chloé", in every display.
The mark and the avatars are not read on their own.
With onShowReaders the element has the button role, a click action and a touch target of at least 48dp; without it, it has no role and no action.
The text and the avatars grow with the font size setting, and long text wraps.
edgeCases: A maxAvatars of 0 or less still shows one face.
With one reader more than maxAvatars, every face is shown instead of a "+1" tile.
